system.description: Spend a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait to expel a cloud of liquid shadow that envelops a target within 50 steps, inflicting the effects of Shroud of Night. Each turn the victim must win a Static Physical Challenge against a five-Trait difficulty or lose a Blood Trait to the cloud. You must maintain concentration to sustain it; if attacked, the cloud rushes back to you. Voluntarily recalling it lets you absorb up to half the drained Blood Traits (counts as drinking from the victim for bond purposes).
system.duration: Until cloud is recalled or you are attacked
